name: T-Mobile Go5G
autoPayAssumptions: Pricing reflects a $5/line monthly discount with eligible AutoPay using a linked checking account (ACH) or debit card ($5 for 1 line, $10 for 2 lines, $15 for 3 lines, $20 for 4 lines, $25 for 5 lines). Without AutoPay, cost is $80 for 1 line, $140 for 2 lines, $170 for 3 lines, $200 for 4 lines, and $230 for 5 lines. Standard credit cards and credit-card backed mobile wallets (Apple Pay / Google Pay with credit card) are NOT eligible for AutoPay discount. Note on promotional vs. non-promotional rates: T-Mobile marketing frequently advertises 3 lines for $130, 4 lines for $155, or 5 lines for $180 by applying a conditional '3rd Line on Us' monthly bill credit for qualifying accounts, but the standard non-promotional recurring rate per FCC Broadband Facts is $155 for 3 lines ($170 undiscounted), $180 for 4 lines ($200 undiscounted), and $205 for 5 lines ($230 undiscounted). Note on audit proposal: The proposed values of $185 (4 lines) and $215 (5 lines) correspond to Go5G Plus promotional rates with 3rd-line free ($150 2-line base + $35 line 4 = $185) rather than standard Go5G ($180 for 4 lines, $205 for 5 lines).
taxAndFeeAssumptions: Monthly recurring service plan pricing INCLUDES standard regulatory fees and monthly sales taxes for qualifying consumer accounts.
dataAndHotspotFeatures: 100 GB premium high-speed mobile data per month before potential deprioritization
15 GB high-speed mobile hotspot data included, then unlimited at 3G speeds
Monthly taxes and regulatory fees included in base service price
Standard non-promotional multi-line pricing: 3 lines $155 ($170 without AutoPay), 4 lines $180 ($200 without AutoPay), 5 lines $205 ($230 without AutoPay)
eligibilityCriteria: Available to existing T-Mobile accounts and grandfathered account holders (new consumer activations have migrated to Experience plan tiers); existing customers can maintain plans and add lines
Supports accounts with 1 to 5+ voice lines
